summary: Added runtime volume/concurrency regressions for concurrent writer bursts, stale-lock recovery, concurrent CLI state writes through dependency projection and sync refresh, and stable spooled result envelopes. Fixed automatic stale-lock recovery so it only removes the stale owner it observed and cannot delete a replacement writer lock.
